blocks.text: Recycling kachre ke intizam, wasail ke bachao aur tawanai ki bachat ka ahem hissa hai. Phir bhi jadeed materials ki recycling aur dobara istemal ki sakht takneeki, maashi aur mahol ki hudood hain, aur zyada pecheeda masnoi products ke saath zehreelapan aur pa-idar disposal barhti fikr ban gaye hain.

Recycling landfills mein jane wala thos kachra kam karti aur mehdood qudrati wasail jaise metals, tel aur lakri bachati hai. Yeh tawanai bhi bachati hai: aluminium ki recycling mein us ki kachi ore se aluminium nikalne ke muqable 95 feesad kam tawanai lagti hai.

items: Alag karna: zyada tar products (maslan mobile phones aur laptops) mile jule materials se bane hote hain jo aasani se alag nahi hote, jaise metals par plastic ki tah ya kai tahon wali packaging films.

Mehngi reprocessing: chhantai, safai aur doosre qadam mehnge hain, aur plastics aur electronics ki reprocessing mein bohat tawanai lagti hai, jo tab ghair-maashi hai jab material kaheen aur sasta mil jaye.

Aaloodgi (contamination): recycled metals aur plastics dyes, kimiyai maddon ya hayatiyati maddon se aaloodah ho sakte hain, jis se un ka mayaar aur hifazat kam hoti hai; aaloodah plastic khane ke istemal (food-grade) ke liye recycle nahi ho sakta.

blocks.caption: Table 31.3 Kuch ahem materials ki recycling ke usool aur tareeqe
rows: Chhantai, safai, pighlana aur dobara shakal dena; aaloodgi aur polymer chains ki kharabi se mehdood
Hararat, solvents ya catalysts se polymer chains ko asal monomers ya saada kimiyai maddon mein torna; zyada khalis reactants milte
Napaki hatane ke liye pighlana aur saaf karna; kafi tawanai chahiye, lekin naye sire se banane se kaheen kam
Reshon ki kimiyai aur mechanical alehdgi; siyahi aur rang hatane ke liye pulp ko NaOH ya Na2CO3 jaise kimiyai maddon se treat kiya jata
Purane sheeshe (cullet) ko saaf karna, torna aur pighla kar naya sheesha banana; kimiyai taur par saada, kyunke sheesha ghair-qalmi (non-crystalline) thos hai

blocks.alt: Plastics ke do flow charts. Mechanical recycling: jama aur chhantai, safai, pighlana, nai cheezon mein dhalna; chains kharab hoti aur aaloodgi ise mehdood karti. Chemical recycling: polymer chains hararat, solvents ya catalysts se monomers ya saada kimiyai maddon mein tootti hain, jin se naya polymer banta. Neeche: metals pighla kar saaf (recycled aluminium mein taqreeban 95% kam tawanai), kaghaz ki pulping aur NaOH ya Na2CO3 se de-inking, aur sheeshe ka cullet saaf, toot kar pighlaya jata.
blocks.caption: Recycling ke raste (Table 31.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Mechanical recycling polymer ko jaisa hai waisa dobara use karti, is liye har baar mayaar girta hai. Chemical recycling polymer ko wapas monomers mein torti, is liye naya polymer asal jitna achha ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Zehreele materials se hone wale khatron ki do qismein batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: sehat ke khatre, tabai khatre aur mahol ke khatre.

blocks.prompt: (i) khali metal ke dabbe, (ii) khali sheeshe ki botlein, (iii) shopping bags aur khilone recycle karne ke liye kaun se tareeqe use karenge?
blocks.explanation: (i) Thermal aur kimiyai refining: metal pighla kar saaf karna. (ii) Cullet ki tayyari aur pighlana. (iii) Yeh plastics hain: mechanical recycling (chhantai, safai, pighlana, dhalna) ya chemical recycling (depolymerisation).

blocks.prompt: Heavy metals food chain mein kaise dakhil hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Phenke gaye electronics, batteries aur lights se yeh mitti aur zameeni pani mein reasti hain; paude aur machhli jaise aabi jandaar inhein lete hain, aur janwar aur insan unhein khate hain.

blocks.prompt: Recycling qudrati wasail bachane mein kaise madad karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Recycled metals, plastics (tel se) aur kaghaz (lakri se) naye kache maal ki jagah lete hain, is liye kam wasail nikalne parte hain; yeh tawanai bhi bachati (aluminium recycling mein 95% kam) aur landfill ka kachra kam karti hai.

items: Recycling wasail aur tawanai bachati (Al: 95% kam tawanai).
Plastics: mechanical ya chemical; metals: refining; kaghaz: pulping, de-inking; sheesha: cullet.
